title: Shanghai Marathon passes stage one of candidate assessment
claims: Abbott World Marathon Majors states that the Shanghai Marathon will proceed to the second stage of the candidacy process in its attempt to join the series.
The marathon was assessed for the second time in November 2025 and met all the criteria set by Abbott World Marathon Majors to pass stage one.
Shanghai must meet the criteria for a second consecutive year when it stages its next marathon on 6 December 2026, and if successful would join the Majors in 2027.

The page names Shanghai as one of two races still requiring one more pass of the AbbottWMM criteria, alongside the Sanlam Cape Town Marathon, and says the series would comprise nine races in 2027 if both are successful.
The page does not describe Shanghai as a Major at the time of publication; it describes the race as a candidate in the evaluation process.
